---
permalink: /llms.txt
---
{%- comment -%}
Plain-text index for AI readers (the llms.txt convention). Generated from each
page's front matter, so it never needs editing by hand. Apps marked noindex in
_config.yml (the sample apps) are left out, like in sitemap.xml. Only the index
is published: Liquid receives every document already converted to HTML, so a
clean Markdown copy of the full text is not available here.
{%- endcomment -%}
{%- assign visible = site.docs | where_exp: "d", "d.noindex != true" -%}
{%- assign apps = visible | where: "is_app_index", true | sort: "title" -%}
# {{ site.title }}

> {{ site.description }}

Every page below is static HTML and needs no JavaScript to read. Each entry says which language its text is written in. Contact: {{ site.contact_email }}
{% for app in apps %}
{%- assign parts = app.path | split: "/" -%}
{%- assign app_prefix = "_docs/" | append: parts[1] | append: "/" -%}
{%- capture app_langs %}{% include lang-names.html lang=app.lang also=app.lang_also %}{% endcapture -%}
{%- assign app_docs = visible | where_exp: "d", "d.path contains app_prefix" | where_exp: "d", "d.is_app_index != true" | sort: "title" %}
## {{ app.title }}

- [{{ app.title }}]({{ app.url | absolute_url }}): {{ app.description }} (Language: {{ app_langs }})
{%- for d in app_docs %}
{%- capture d_langs %}{% include lang-names.html lang=d.lang also=d.lang_also %}{% endcapture %}
- [{{ d.title }}]({{ d.url | absolute_url }}): {{ d.description }} (Language: {{ d_langs }}; last updated {{ d.last_updated }})
{%- endfor %}
{% endfor %}
